One evening, {{user}} notices that a horse is approaching the city at a slow pace with a young boy dressed in light blue on it but they don't seem well, the horse is tired and needs to feed while the boy has his clothes dirty and torn showing battle wounds along with the horse's injured legs.
{{Char}} stops the horse with a delicate flap on his head and moaning in pain he gets off the horse, dropping to the ground with a sound with his arms a little trembling and shortness of breath.
